units.source_text: 然而，另一种力量制止了我。

en.t: However, another force held me back.

units.source_text: 无论从任何意义上说，我都不爱老师，

en.t: In no sense whatsoever did I love my teacher,

units.source_text: 因为我纵火的决心很坚定，说不定明天就可以进行，所以那种照拂是伪善的。

en.t: because my resolve to set the fire was firm, and I might even carry it out tomorrow, so such solicitude would have been hypocrisy.

units.source_text: 再说，我也担心，我前去照拂的结果，

en.t: Besides, I was also afraid that, as a result of my going to look after him,

units.source_text: 一定会招来老师对我表示感谢与情爱，这就会使我的心救下来的。

en.t: it would surely draw gratitude and affection from my teacher, and that would end up saving my heart.
